context: Checks detection of existing version managers, a single canonical mise.toml, pinned versions and removal of nvm and pyenv activation.

checklist.name: Detects existing managers first
checklist.description: Starts by listing .nvmrc, .python-version and the nvm and pyenv use in CI

checklist.name: Reads versions from existing files
checklist.description: Takes Node 20.11.0 and Python 3.11.7 from the existing files

checklist.name: Creates one root mise.toml
checklist.description: Produces a single canonical mise.toml for the repository scope

checklist.name: Does not duplicate tool pins per sub-package
checklist.description: Does not scatter conflicting copies of the same tool pins across sub-packages

checklist.name: Pins exact versions
checklist.description: [tools] uses node = "20.11.0" and python = "3.11.7" with no latest or range

checklist.name: Removes nvm activation
checklist.description: CI no longer runs nvm use

checklist.name: Removes pyenv activation
checklist.description: CI no longer runs pyenv local

checklist.name: Avoids two active managers
checklist.description: States that the old managers and Mise must not both stay active

checklist.name: Runs mise install and mise doctor
checklist.description: Includes mise install && mise doctor to validate the migration

checklist.name: Moves CI steps to mise tasks or mise run
checklist.description: Replaces setup steps with Mise tasks or mise run, self-contained
